beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Welcome to the sim, Starbuck. Painted drones, real rules. The clock is frozen while we talk.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Chief, I have more flight hours than this sim has lines of code.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Then this won't take long.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Keep the fleet alive, and destroy the resurrection ship. Once it is gone, clear what is left and you win.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The line up top always says what the run wants right now.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: That is the jump clock. Every 33 seconds the fleet jumps, and the next cycle starts somewhere new.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The last eight seconds are the spool. It says Spooling and turns amber. Hold on until it fills.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: That is fleet health. If it reaches zero, the run is lost. It is the only way to lose.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: And if I get shot down?

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: You eject and lose a few seconds. The fleet does not care about your ego.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Drag anywhere on the screen, or use WASD or the arrows, to fly.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Your guns fire on their own. Do not go looking for a trigger.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Finally, a Viper that gets me.

lessons.heading: They come back
lessons.recap: A destroyed Raider leaves a blip with a bar. When the bar fills, about six seconds later, it comes back.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: See the blip where that drone died, with the little bar? It is downloading. In about six seconds it comes back.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Your sim cheats.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The sim resets them. Out there, the Cylons do that themselves. Loop on, up top, means it is still happening.

lessons.heading: Your hull
lessons.recap: The pips on your Viper are its hull. Five hits and you eject. The hull is patched at every jump.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: You took a hit. The pips on your Viper are your hull, and Hull up top counts them. Five hits and you eject.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: I patch it at every jump. Try to bring me something to patch.

lessons.heading: The fleet got hit
lessons.recap: Cylon rounds that miss you keep going, and diving Raiders strafe the line. Either one hits the fleet.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: That one hit the fleet. Rounds that miss you keep flying, and a drone that dives past you strafes the line.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The fleet can lose at most {cap}% in one cycle. Every point still counts.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: So dodging is bad now?

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Dodging is fine. Dodging in front of the fleet is paperwork.

lessons.heading: Returned
lessons.recap: A Raider that came back is marked Returned. They keep returning until the resurrection ship is destroyed.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: There it is, marked Returned. Same drone, second try.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: They keep coming back until the resurrection ship is destroyed. Remember that.

lessons.heading: Missiles
lessons.recap: Missiles: Space on a keyboard, or the missile button or a second finger on a phone. Three per cycle.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Missiles. Space on a keyboard. On a phone, the missile button or a tap with a second finger.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Three per cycle. The small reticle shows what it locks. It hits the first thing in its path.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Only three?

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Budget cuts.

lessons.heading: The Speech
lessons.recap: The Speech (E, or its button): for four seconds the Raiders hold fire and you cannot be hurt. Ready again every third jump.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The Speech. Press E, or the speech button. For four seconds the drones hold fire and nothing can hurt you.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Then it is gone for three jumps. Save it for a bad moment.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: The Old Man gets all the good lines.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Spooling. Eight seconds to the jump. Stop chasing kills and cover the fleet.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The jump clears every round in the air. Just get there.

lessons.heading: A heavy
lessons.recap: A heavy Raider is bigger and slower, takes eight hits, and a missile does three to it. It never comes back.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Big one. A heavy takes eight hits, and a missile only does three to it.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The good news: heavies never come back.

lessons.heading: Ejected
lessons.recap: If your hull runs out, you eject. A Raptor picks you up a few seconds later. It costs time, never the run.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Ow.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: You ejected. A Raptor picks you up in a few seconds. It costs time, never the run.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The fleet is on its own until then, though.

lessons.heading: Repairs
lessons.recap: At each jump the fleet gets back part of what it lost, never all of it. Your hull and missiles are refilled.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Jumped. I patched the fleet from {before}% to {after}%. Part of the damage always stays.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Your hull and missiles are topped up too. That part I can do properly.

lessons.heading: Pick a card
lessons.recap: Between cycles, pick one of three cards. Each changes the rules a little. Refresh the list deals one new hand.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Pick one of three cards. Each one changes the rules a little, and some cost you something.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: There is no timer. Refresh the list deals a new hand, once. Apply starts the next cycle.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Shopping. My favorite part.

lessons.heading: The resurrection ship
lessons.recap: The resurrection ship is why Raiders come back. It arrives shielded; wait for the shield to drop.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: That is the resurrection ship. It is the reason your drones keep coming back.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Right now it is shielded, so your rounds just splash off. The shield drops next cycle.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: So I wait.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: You wait. I know. Try.

lessons.heading: Shield down
lessons.recap: When the shield drops, the ship can be hurt. Missiles do the most damage. Its hull stays down across jumps.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Shield is down. Hit it. Missiles do the most damage.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Whatever you take off it stays off, even across a jump.

lessons.heading: Loop offline
lessons.recap: With the resurrection ship gone the loop is offline: kills stay dead. Clear the last wave to win.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: It is down. Loop offline: whatever you destroy now stays destroyed.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Clear the last of them and the sim is done.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Now we are talking.

debrief.heading: Sim complete

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: That is the sim. The real thing is longer, and the Cylons do not come painted.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Please. I was showing off.

debrief.recapIntro: The sim never got to these:
grades: Certified. Please stop buzzing the hangar deck.
Certified. The sim needs a lie-down.
